source_title: Kemenko Polkam BSSN dan Perbankan Dalami Gelombang Serangan Siber di RI
precise_claim: FortiGuard dashboard snapshot on 2026-11-09 at 20:00 WIB reported approximately 1.2 million detected threat activities targeting Indonesia financial and banking sectors in the preceding 24 hours.
limitations: Time-dependent vendor telemetry; not evidence of successful bank compromise.

source_title: OJK minta bank waspadai serangan siber nasabah diminta tetap tenang
precise_claim: OJK reported coordination with bank IT personnel since 2026-11-06 and requested heightened vigilance and monitoring of significant or anomalous transactions.
limitations: Reported regulatory statement; not evidence of noncompliance or a confirmed breach.

source_title: BSSN ungkap mitigasi Indonesia hadapi jutaan serangan siber
precise_claim: BSSN clarified that FortiGuard detected threat activity does not necessarily represent confirmed cybersecurity incidents in the financial sector.
limitations: No bank-specific forensic evidence or confirmed compromise established.
